title: New South Institute
description: Website for a research and advocacy institute on fragile democracies, public service reform, and South-South dialogues.
body: I contributed to the new website for the New South Institute (NSI), devoted to addressing complex challenges in fragile democracies through evidence-based research and policy advocacy. NSI's initiatives include programs on state capture, public service reform, migration governance, and South-South Dialogues — fostering effective, accountable institutions across the Global South.
